sources.researchNote: A reverse image search matched the local reproduction to this image, and the same card is offered elsewhere from the Everett Collection. The image details were read in a browser on 6 November 2026; the page refuses automated requests. The card itself prints a 1936 copyright notice for Universal Pictures Corporation, so the agency’s public-domain description is not adopted here.

media.title: Three Smart Girls (1936) — lobby card
media.description: Lobby card for Three Smart Girls (Universal Pictures, 1936), announcing “the screen debut of Deanna Durbin, radio’s sensational songbird” with Binnie Barnes, Alice Brady, Ray Milland and Charles Winninger. Kaper and Jurmann contributed songs to the film.
media.altText: Lobby card for the Universal Pictures film Three Smart Girls (1936).
media.rightsNote: Reuse rights are not cleared. The bottom margin reads “COUNTRY OF ORIGIN U.S.A. COPYRIGHTED 1936 BY UNIVERSAL PICTURES CORPORATION”. Whether the registration was renewed has not been checked. The reproduction matches the card Alamy offers from the Everett Collection, as an image to which it grants access only, without warranty as to copyright. The status remains undetermined and the local copy is confined to the film record.
